simpleadmin.title: About Simple T99
simpleadmin.description: Management interface for the Foxconn T99W175 modem.
simpleadmin.intro: Simple T99 (SimpleAdmin) runs on the modem it manages. Live radio data comes from the Qualcomm DIAG interface and QMI through two small bridges, so the dashboard costs the modem almost nothing while it is open.
